description: Select text in Chat, Markdown preview, Release Notes, Settings and more, then hover the red dot for an instant dictionary or AI translation. Paragraph and full-page translation included.
config.targetLanguage: Language to translate into. The bundled offline dictionary (ECDICT) covers English → Chinese only; for other languages every translation uses the AI model.
config.uiLanguage: Language of the popup, notifications and messages. `auto` follows the VS Code display language.
config.surfaces: Where selection translation and the paragraph/page shortcuts are active. Text editors are never affected.
config.surfaces.chat: Chat (responses, question boxes, tool confirmations, input notices)
config.surfaces.workbenchUI: Notifications, dialogs, hover cards, Workspace Trust and view messages
config.shortcuts.paragraph: Shortcut that translates (or restores) the paragraph under the mouse, e.g. `Alt+Z` or `Ctrl+Shift+Y`. Leave empty to disable. Outside supported surfaces the key keeps its normal VS Code meaning. These shortcuts are handled inside the page, so they are configured here rather than in Keyboard Shortcuts.
config.shortcuts.fullPage: Shortcut that toggles full-page translation of the surface you are working in, e.g. `Alt+W`. Leave empty to disable.
config.shortcuts.error: Use modifiers joined with + and one key, e.g. Alt+Z, Ctrl+Shift+Y or F8. Leave empty to disable.
config.fullPage.mode.translationOnly: Translation only: replace the original text (press the shortcut again to restore).
config.fullPage.mode.bilingual: Bilingual: show the translation below the original.
config.ai.autoTranslate: Automatically use the AI model when the offline dictionary has no entry (phrases, sentences, paragraphs). When off, click **AI translate** in the popup.
config.ai.modelId: VS Code language model ID used when **AI Provider** is `VS Code Language Models`. Empty = automatically prefer a lightweight model. Pick one from the list in the Translate Anywhere sidebar or with **Translate Anywhere: Select AI Model**.
config.integration.enabled: Consent to add a reversible UI script to the local VS Code installation (required for translation in Chat, previews and Settings). Use **Translate Anywhere: Disable and Restore VS Code** to remove it.
config.integration.autoRepair: Reapply the UI integration automatically after VS Code updates replace its files.
config.ai.provider: Which AI service translates phrases, sentences and paragraphs. `VS Code Language Models` uses models you already have in VS Code (for example GitHub Copilot) and needs no API key. Other providers call their HTTP API directly with a key stored in VS Code's encrypted Secret Storage (set it with **Translate Anywhere: Set API Key**).
config.ai.apiModel: Model name for the selected HTTP provider, e.g. `gpt-4o-mini`, `claude-haiku-4-5`, `deepseek-chat`, `qwen-flash`. Empty = the provider's default lightweight model.
config.ai.baseUrl: Override the API base URL of the selected HTTP provider (OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic), e.g. a proxy, Azure-compatible gateway or `http://localhost:11434/v1` for Ollama. Required for the `Custom` provider. Empty = the provider's default.
config.ai.baseUrl.error: Enter an http:// or https:// URL, or leave empty.
config.dictionary.autoDownload: Download the offline English-Chinese dictionary (ECDICT, about 15 MB) on first use. It is fetched from GitHub with jsDelivr mirrors as fallbacks and verified with SHA-256. Not needed if you installed the offline VSIX or set **Dictionary: Path**.
config.dictionary.path: Absolute path of a local dictionary file (`.json.gz`, the same format as the published `dictionary.json.gz`). Overrides the bundled and downloaded dictionaries. Empty = default.
config.dictionary.downloadUrl: Extra HTTPS URL tried first when downloading the dictionary, e.g. an internal mirror. The file must match the published SHA-256.
config.dictionary.downloadUrl.error: Enter an https:// URL, or leave empty.
config.dictionary.german: Look up selected German words in the offline German–Chinese dictionary ([HanDeDict](https://handedict.zydeo.net/), CC BY-SA 3.0). It is downloaded once (about 3 MB) the first time you select a German word; until then, and for phrases, AI translation is used.
